raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer defaulted to manual scrolling on Redfin to locate January 2023 sales instead of immediately using date and property-type filters. This inefficient navigation led to a looping pattern (multiple consecutive scroll_down actions with no progress) and later to misconfigured filters (entering both start and end dates into the same field), preventing retrieval of the needed data. The early choice to scroll rather than apply precise filters set the process off-course and directly contributed to the failure to find and report the correct lowest sale price (1,010,000).
